name: @uzmigames/uzengine
description: UzEngine — AAA game engine embedded in VSCode

scripts.build: npm run build:runtime && npm run build:napi && npm run copy:node && npm run build:extension && npm run build:mcp
scripts.build:debug: npm run build:runtime:debug && npm run build:napi:debug && npm run copy:node && npm run build:extension && npm run build:mcp
scripts.lint: cd extension && npm run lint && cd ../mcp && npm run lint
scripts.lint:fix: cd extension && npm run lint:fix && cd ../mcp && npm run lint:fix
scripts.format: cd extension && npm run format && cd ../mcp && npm run format
scripts.format:check: cd extension && npm run format:check && cd ../mcp && npm run format:check
scripts.test: cd extension && npm test && cd ../mcp && npm test
scripts.prepush: npm run test:layouts && npm run build && npm test && npm run test:coverage
scripts.test:coverage: cd extension && npm run test:coverage && cd ../mcp && npm run test:coverage
